references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah about being struck and spat upon as part of the suffering, which mirrors the treatment Jesus received before crucifixion.
The psalm that prophetically describes the dividing of garments, seen in parallel with the soldiers dressing Jesus in his own clothes after mocking him.
The psalm expressing shame and pain, similar to what Jesus experienced, including references to being mocked and given gall to drink.
Matthew's description of how the soldiers mocked Jesus, dressed him in a scarlet robe, and then put his own clothes back on him before crucifixion.
Luke's description of how Herod and his soldiers mocked Jesus by dressing him in an elegant robe.
John's description of how the soldiers wove a crown of thorns, placed it on Jesus' head, dressed him in a purple robe, and mocked him as 'King of the Jews'.
